<div class="card-body">
'''Doikk Na'ts''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ドイック・ナッツ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">同じ位置カード上にいる他のミュージシャン1名につき、双方のプレイヤーとも、この位置での戦闘で運命数を引くために必要な能力値が1多くなる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Doikk-Nats-PSA-164793237.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ビス男性のミュージシャン。フィグリン・ダンのバンドでフィッツ（曲名ドアリニアン・ベシュニケル）を演奏する。知的生命体、なかでも人間嫌いが激しく、ドロイドと一緒に働く方が性に合う。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Doikk Na'ts.

'''Card text:'''
For each other musician at the same location card, the ability required to draw battle destiny here increases by 1 for both players.

'''Lore:'''
A male Bith musician. He plays fizz (the piece Dorenian Beshniquel) in Figrin D'an's band. He strongly dislikes sentients, especially humans, and prefers working with droids.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Doikk Na'ts]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
